title: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (inflation adjustments for taxable years beginning in 2026 and returns required to be filed in 2027)

passages.question: What is the penalty amount for returns required to be filed in 2027?
passages.excerpt: Failure to File Partnership Return. In the case of any return required to be filed in 2027, the dollar amount used to determine the amount of the penalty under § 6698(b)(1) is $260.
